panels.description: One row per running plasma container (cAdvisor). Status reflects whether the container's metrics endpoint is reachable (up).

targets.expr: max by(name, network, service, repository, tag) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(time() - container_start_time_seconds{name=~".*-(execution|consensus)$",network=~"$network"}, "tag", "$2", "image", "^([^@]+):([^:@]+)(@sha256:[^:]+)?$"), "repository", "$1", "image", "^([^@]+):([^:@]+)(@sha256:[^:]+)?$"), "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)"))
